sections.title: باب 3 — متن (21)

paras.text: Economic Development and Release from Debts
paras.urdu: معاشی ترقی اور قرض سے چھٹکارا (Economic Development and Release from Debts)
paras.pashto: اقتصادي پرمختګ او له پورونو خلاصون

paras.text: The most important thing for Pakistan’s economic development is that release be obtained from the burden of world institutions and foreign loans. To obtain release from world loans for Pakistan’s economic development there is a need to discourage imports. The government should adopt the path of self-reliance and austerity, and while bringing into use all the resources of the country there is also a need to awaken public thinking in this regard. There is a need for a complete ban on the import of such goods as are not basic necessities of life. The people too should adopt a practical strategy of self-reliance to face difficult conditions. An important problem of the Pakistani people is also that people give preference to foreign products over national products. To some extent the people are also right, because the quality of national goods is bad and prices touch the sky. Here there is no government eye on quality or prices either. But here a culture has also developed that the use of foreign goods has become a sign of modernity, and the use of these goods has become a fashion. To support national industry and adopt the path of self-reliance the use of local goods is necessary. In this way national capital will not go to other countries.

By preparing high-quality goods at low cost, exports can be increased, because of which the country’s role in world trade can increase. Hence the need is this, that non-development expenditures be controlled and serious efforts be made to stop corruption …

Economic Development and Release from Debts

The most important thing for Pakistan’s economic development is that release be obtained from the burden of world institutions and foreign loans. To obtain release from world loans for Pakistan’s economic development there is a need to discourage imports. The government should adopt the path of self-reliance and austerity, and while bringing into use all the resources of the country there is also a need to awaken public thinking in this regard. There is a need for a complete ban on the import of such goods as are not basic necessities of life. The people too should adopt a practical strategy of self-reliance to face difficult conditions. An important problem of the Pakistani people is also that people give preference to foreign products over national products. To some extent the people are also right, because the quality of national goods is bad and prices touch the sky. Here there is no government eye on quality or prices either. But here a culture has also developed that the use of foreign goods has become a sign of modernity, and the use of these goods has become a fashion. To support national industry and adopt the path of self-reliance the use of local goods is necessary. In this way national capital will not go to other countries.

Industry and industrial products are a very important source of the country’s income. By preparing high-quality goods at low cost, exports can be increased, because of which the country’s role in world trade can increase. Capital can come into the country, which can become a cause of discouraging world loans. To promote the trend towards industrialisation the government should announce incentives and concessions. Investment should be encouraged and attention should be given to government and private cooperation. Technical education should be given importance. Unfortunately the dependence of the national economy is on foreign loans. On the other hand the lavish spending of the government and bureaucracy are also unparalleled. Money is spent on unnecessary matters, or is spent in such places from which no development productive importance comes. In offices there is a culture of unnecessary use of resources. Important office-bearers have become habituated to corruption and there is no one to ask. Therefore, to stop the waste of wealth, there is a severe need for meaningful reforms in every sector of life. Hence the need is this, that non-development expenditures be controlled and serious efforts be made to stop corruption …

paras.text: Impacts of International Debt on the Policies and Citizens of Pakistan
paras.urdu: عالمی قرض کا پاکستان کی پالیسیوں اور شہریوں پر اثرات (Impacts of International Debt on the Policies and Citizens of Pakistan):
paras.pashto: د پاکستان پر پالیسیو او اتباعو د نړیوال پور اغېزې

paras.text: Pakistan at this time is caught in the loans of world powers, the IMF and the World Bank etc. In this situation there is a deep effect on the policies and citizens of the country. A country or individual crushed under loans can never be called self-respecting. Such countries and individuals are not seen with respect and dignity in the community. Self-respecting, honourable, dignified behaviour can be expected only when the country or individual is not under the burden of loans. Honour is attacked when loans taken are wasted on luxury and extravagance. The fact is that because of these loans we do not have a real dignified position in the international community. We have to bow our heads before the lawful and unlawful conditions of the loan-givers, which is against self-respect. When we take steps to end world loans and make the stable economic system certain, then with greatness we will become capable of raising our heads at the world level. World loans are harmful for the freedom of the country, its sovereignty and maintaining a sovereign position. A free and sovereign country is free from any external pressure, demands and conditions. When a loan is obtained from any foreign country or institution, then its conditions and demands have to be accepted.
paras.urdu: پاکستان اِس وقت عالمی طاقتوں، آئی ایم ایف اور عالمی بینک وغیرہ کے قرضوں میں پھنسا ہوا ہے۔ اِس صورتِ حال کی ملک کے پالیسیوں اور شہریوں پر گہرا اثر ہوتا ہے۔ قرض تلے دبا ہوا ملک یا فرد کو کبھی بھی خوددار نہیں کہا جا سکتا۔ ایسے ممالک اور افراد برادری میں عزت اور وقار کی نظر سے نہیں دیکھے جاتے۔ خوددار، باعزت، باوقار سلوک کی توقع تب کی جا سکتی ہے جب ملک یا فرد قرض کے بوجھ تلے نہ ہو۔ عزت پر اُس وقت سخت حرف آتی ہے جب لئے گئے قرض کو عیش و عشرت اور فضولیات پر ضائع کیا جائے۔ حقیقت یہ ہے کہ اِن قرضوں کی وجہ سے بین الاقوامی برادری میں ہمیں حقیقی باوقار مقام حاصل نہیں۔ ہمیں قرض دینے والوں کے جائز و ناجائز شرائط کے سامنے سرِ تسلیم خم کرنا پڑتا ہے جو خودی کے خلاف ہے۔ جب عالمی قرض کو ختم کرنے اور مستحکم معاشی نظام کو یقینی بنانے کیلئے ٹھوس اِقدامات کئے جائیں گے اور کشکول کو توڑیں گے تو ہم عظمت کے ساتھ عالمی سطح پر سر اُٹھانے کے قابل بن جائیں گے۔ عالمی قرض ملک کی آزادی، خودمختاری اور مقتدر حیثیت برقرار رکھنے کیلئے مضر ہے۔ ایک آزاد اور مقتدر ملک کسی بیرونی دباؤ، مطالبے اور شرط سے آزاد ہوتا ہے۔ جب کسی بیرونی ملک یا اِدارے سے قرض حاصل کیا جاتا ہے تو اُن کی شرائط اور مطالبات ماننے پڑتے ہیں۔
paras.pashto: پاکستان اوس مهال د نړیوالو ځواکونو، IMF او نړیوال بانک او نورو په پورونو کې ښکېل دی. دا حالت د هېواد پر پالیسیو او اتباعو ژور اغېز کوي. د پور لاندې ځپل شوی هېواد یا کس هېڅکله ځان‌ساتی نه شي بلل کېدای. داسې هېوادونه او افراد په ټولنه کې په درناوي او وقار نه کتل کېږي. د ځان‌ساتي، باعزته او باوقاره چلند تمه هغه وخت کېدای شي چې هېواد یا کس د پور تر بار لاندې نه وي. عزت ته هغه وخت سخت زیان رسېږي چې اخیستل شوی پور په عیش او عشرت او بې‌ځایه شیانو ضایع شي. حقیقت دا دی چې د دې پورونو له امله په نړیواله ټولنه کې موږ ته ریښتینی باوقاره ځای حاصل نه دی. موږ باید د پور ورکوونکو مشروعو او نامشروعو شرطونو ته سر ټیټ کړو چې د ځان‌پېژندنې خلاف دی. کله چې د نړیوال پور د ختمولو او د باثباته اقتصادي نظام د ډاډمنولو لپاره کلک ګامونه پورته شي او کشکول مات کړو، نو په عظمت به په نړیواله کچه د سر پورته کولو وړ شو. نړیوال پور د هېواد د ازادۍ، خپلواکۍ او واکمن حیثیت د ساتلو لپاره زیانمن دی. یو ازاد او واکمن هېواد له هر بهرني فشار، غوښتنې او شرط ازاد وي. کله چې له کوم بهرني هېواد یا ادارې پور واخیستل شي، د هغوی شرطونه او غوښتنې منل پکار کېږي.

پاکستان اِس وقت عالمی طاقتوں، آئی ایم ایف اور عالمی بینک وغیرہ کے قرضوں میں پھنسا ہوا ہے۔ اِس صورتِ حال کی ملک کے پالیسیوں اور شہریوں پر گہرا اثر ہوتا ہے۔ قرض تلے دبا ہوا ملک یا فرد کو کبھی بھی خوددار نہیں کہا جا سکتا۔ ایسے ممالک اور افراد برادری میں عزت اور وقار کی نظر سے نہیں دیکھے جاتے۔ خوددار، باعزت، باوقار سلوک کی توقع تب کی جا سکتی ہے جب ملک یا فرد قرض کے بوجھ تلے نہ ہو۔ عزت پر اُس وقت سخت حرف آتی ہے جب لئے گئے قرض کو عیش و عشرت اور فضولیات پر ضائع کیا جائے۔ حقیقت یہ ہے کہ اِن قرضوں کی وجہ سے بین الاقوامی برادری میں ہمیں حقیقی باوقار مقام حاصل نہیں۔ ہمیں قرض دینے والوں کے جائز و ناجائز شرائط کے سامنے سرِ تسلیم خم کرنا پڑتا ہے جو خودی کے خلاف ہے۔ جب عالمی قرض کو ختم کرنے اور مستحکم معاشی نظام کو یقینی بنانے کیلئے ٹھوس اِقدامات کئے جائیں گے اور کشکول کو توڑیں گے تو ہم عظمت کے ساتھ عالمی سطح پر سر اُٹھانے کے قابل بن جائیں گے۔ عالمی قرض ملک کی آزادی، خودمختاری اور مقتدر حیثیت برقرار رکھنے کیلئے مضر ہے۔ ایک آزاد اور مقتدر ملک کسی بیرونی دباؤ، مطالبے اور شرط سے آزاد ہوتا ہے۔ جب کسی بیرونی ملک یا اِدارے سے قرض حاصل کیا جاتا ہے تو اُن کی شرائط اور مطالبات ماننے پڑتے ہیں۔

… be made. Tax evasion too should be stopped with an iron hand, so that the government’s income increases.

In Pakistan the rate of general education is low and then the trend towards technical and scientific education is very weak. Self-employment plans should be made to end unemployment, and for this purpose people should be encouraged to obtain technical and scientific education. Manpower is meaningless at the national level until the majority of people obtains skill or technical training. Expert people become the support of the national economy. When the national economy is stable, then external loans can end.

Impacts of International Debt on the Policies and Citizens of Pakistan

Pakistan at this time is caught in the loans of world powers, the IMF and the World Bank etc. In this situation there is a deep effect on the policies and citizens of the country. A country or individual crushed under loans can never be called self-respecting. Such countries and individuals are not seen with respect and dignity in the community. Self-respecting, honourable, dignified behaviour can be expected only when the country or individual is not under the burden of loans. Honour is attacked when loans taken are wasted on luxury and extravagance. The fact is that because of these loans we do not have a real dignified position in the international community. We have to bow our heads before the lawful and unlawful conditions of the loan-givers, which is against self-respect. When we take steps to end world loans and make the stable economic system certain, then with greatness we will become capable of raising our heads at the world level. World loans are harmful for the freedom of the country, its sovereignty and maintaining a sovereign position. A free and sovereign country is free from any external pressure, demands and conditions. When a loan is obtained from any foreign country or institution, then its conditions and demands have to be accepted.
